Studio edition · Easy and Manual

Underwriting Support, built with brainfreeze studio

The Underwriting Support agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

Synthetic data only: every record and figure is fictional workshop data, not customer results, verified emissions evidence, a compliance determination, or a credit purchase.

Use the same lists, agent and managed app in either mode. Keep the agent in Draft. Expected results below are checks to run, not claims that a live run has passed.

Progress remains available on this page but will not persist after you leave.
Found something inaccurate? Use Report an issue on that step. It opens a prefilled GitHub issue for your review and never submits automatically.

0 of 9 complete

1

Get the tools and sign in once

Step 1 of 9

Action

Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.

Expected result

The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

Command 1
git clone https://github.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library.git
Command 2
npm install -g @microsoft/managed-apps-cli
Command 3
ms auth login
Command 4
az login
Screenshot pending

A real capture will be added after this step is run live and reviewed. No screenshot is shown; this is not evidence that the step has passed.

2

Build and deploy everything with one command

Step 2 of 9

Action

Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.

Expected result

It prints the 3 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

Command 1
python3 -m brainfreeze_studio aibast underwriting-support --library ./aibast-agents-library --site https://<your-tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<your-site> --environment https://<your-org>.crm.dynamics.com --deploy

2

Create Underwriting Support Applications from its CSV

Step 2 of 24

Action

On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload applications.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ApplicationId, Applicant, LineOfBusiness, PropertyType, Construction, YearBuilt, LossHistory, Status, Underwriter, Vehicle, Specialty, ClaimsHistory, BusinessType to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CoverageRequested, PremiumIndicated, SquareFootage, ProtectionClass, RiskScore, DriverAge, DrivingRecordViolations, DrivingRecordAccidents, DrivingRecordYearsLicensed, CreditScore, Practitioners, YearsInPractice, Locations, AnnualRevenue, Employees as Number. Name the list Underwriting Support Applications. Preserve the CSV column order.

Expected result

4 fictional records, including UW-2025-101 (ApplicationId UW-2025-101), with Applicant Riverside Manufacturing Inc..

Screenshot pending

A real capture will be added after this step is run live and reviewed. No screenshot is shown; this is not evidence that the step has passed.

Download source: applications.csv
3

Create Underwriting Support Underwriting Guidelines from its CSV

Step 3 of 24

Action

On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload underwriting-guidelines.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set UnderwritingGuidelineId, RequiredInspections, ProhibitedRisks, RequiredDocuments, HighRiskSpecialties to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep MaxCoverage, MinProtectionClass, MaxBuildingAge, MaxLossRatio, MinDriverAge, MaxViolations3Yr, MaxAccidents3Yr, MinCreditScore, MaxClaims5Yr, MinYearsPractice, MinYearsBusiness as Number. Name the list Underwriting Support Underwriting Guidelines. Preserve the CSV column order.

Expected result

4 fictional records, including commercial_property (UnderwritingGuidelineId commercial_property), with MaxCoverage 25000000.

4

Create Underwriting Support Pricing Models from its CSV

Step 4 of 24

Action

On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload pricing-models.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set PricingModelId to Single line of text. Keep BaseRatePer100, ConstructionFactorFireResistive, ConstructionFactorMasonry, ConstructionFactorFrame, ProtectionClassFactor1, ProtectionClassFactor2, ProtectionClassFactor3, ProtectionClassFactor4, ProtectionClassFactor5, BasePremium, AgeFactor16, AgeFactor25, AgeFactor30, AgeFactor50, AgeFactor65, CreditFactor800, CreditFactor700, CreditFactor600, CreditFactor500, BaseRatePerPractitioner, SpecialtyFactorFamilyMedicine, SpecialtyFactorOrthopedicSurgery, SpecialtyFactorNeurosurgery, SpecialtyFactorObstetrics, BaseRatePer1000Revenue, IndustryFactorRestaurantChain, IndustryFactorOffice, IndustryFactorRetail, IndustryFactorConstruction as Number. Name the list Underwriting Support Pricing Models. Preserve the CSV column order.

Expected result

4 fictional records, including commercial_property (PricingModelId commercial_property), with BaseRatePer100 0.85.

22

Register the app and connect the lists

Step 22 of 24

Action

In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.

Expected result

ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 3 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

Command 1
cd underwriting-support-app/managed-app
Command 2
ms app init --display-name "Underwriting Support Workspace Manual" --repo native
Command 3
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Underwriting Support Applications" --use-sso
Command 4
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Underwriting Support Underwriting Guidelines" --use-sso
Command 5
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Underwriting Support Pricing Models" --use-sso
Screenshot pending
